quests.title: A Friend for the Road
quests.offer: You've the look of someone who shouldn't walk the roads alone, {name}. I find companions for people like you - folk who'll stand at your shoulder for the long road. Shall I find you a [companion]?
quests.summary: Rowena Ashby of Cotswold Village finds travelling companions for adventurers. Rowena has someone in mind for you.

steps.goal: Speak with Rowena Ashby in Cotswold Village
steps.say:
